III, 9</cite> (<cite ref="Makkot 21b:1">21ᵇ</cite>) <he>יש חורש ת׳ אחד וכ׳</he> (Mish. ed. <he>אחת</he>, corr. acc.) one may plough only one furrow, and be guilty of eight sins (v. <cite ref="L00009"><he>לַאו</he></cite>); <cite ref="Pesachim 47a:8">Pes. 47ᵃ</cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 67:9">Gen. R. s. 67</cite> [read:] <he>אפי׳ הדיוט אינו חורש ת׳ בתוך ת׳ ונביאים חורשים תבתוך ת׳</he> (v. Matt. K. a. l.) even a common man will not plough a ridge within a ridge, and will prophets plough &c. (i.e. mistrust their own previsions)?; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 116:1">Yalk. ib. 116</cite> (corr. acc.); a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="V00635"><he>תְּלָמִים</he></cite>, <cite ref="V00600"><he>תְּלָמִין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 2:6">Kil. II, 6</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="Q02159"><he>פָּתִיחַ</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Yoma 10a:6">Yoma 10ᵃ</cite> <he>תלמי שמשים … ת׳ ת׳</he> his name was Talmai (<cite ref="Numbers 13:22">Num. XIII, 22</cite>), because he made the ground full of ridges (with his steps); <cite ref="Sotah 34b:9">Sot. 34ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 16:11">Num. R. s. 16<sup>11</sup></cite>.
<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 1">Ruth R. to I, 19</cite>, v. <cite ref="T00258"><he>רַדְיָינִית</he></cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 601:14">Yalk. ib. 601</cite> <he>תְּלָמֶיהָ</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 2:3">Kil. II, 3</cite> <he>כתַלְמֵי הרביעה</he> as deep as the furrows made after the rainy season; a. e.
